title_r: Close and Conceptual Replications of Waytz, Dungan, &amp; Young (2013) Studies 2b and 4
abstract_r: Waytz, Dungan, and Young (2013) conducted four studies to test the hypothesis that valuing fairness over loyalty is more strongly associated with willingness to blow the whistle on transgressors than valuing loyalty over fairness. We conducted a close replication of Study 2b, and a conceptual replication of Study 4, using at least 2.5 times the sample sizes of the original studies. Although we replicated Study 2b, we failed to replicate Study 4. We summarize these findings, and speculate as to why we failed to replicate Study 4.
